method: Visible requestAnimationFrame intervals, CPU compute/render submission and callback dispatch delay. GPU render and compute timestamps sampled separately; their last-frame samples are not necessarily paired. Optional queue completion latency includes GPU work, readback and JS delivery; not compositor presentation.

queuePrefix.method: Logical measured draws, excluding the initial interval anchor. Fence IDs are immutable submitted prefixes. Unconfirmed frames are an upper bound on measured draws not yet confirmed to JS, not physical queue depth. Completion-bounded rate uses one local performance.now clock from the anchor observation through final prefix notification; RAF is stored separately and used only for periodic spacing. Includes inherited backlog and JS delivery, not isolated GPU throughput or compositor presentation.

metricSemantics.gpu: sparse last-resolved-frame sum of render-pass intervals
metricSemantics.queuePrefix: benchmark-only completion notifications for immutable logical submitted prefixes; not physical queue depth
